name: extension-host core + desktop + workspace 1.0.2 approved per user over the bundled 1.0.0
comment: Held by scripts/verify-compat-pairs.py (`task compat:verify`) against the headless compatibility host of this tree,
bundling the retained workspace 1.0.0 and given workspace release/schema 1.0.2 approved per user: the same source as
the shipped 1.0.2 with `first-party-selection-v1` stated in its manifest and descriptor, as an earlier host requires
of an update. The served schema is the discovery composition's, so its digest is that composition's. The pins are
what tell the binaries apart, because an identical digest cannot prove which binary ran. The retained 1.0.0 stays a
candidate, REJECTED / NOT_SELECTED as superseded, and is never loaded.
